descricao: On Level 18, a rare Entity can be found, which helps guide wanderers throughout the floor. This Entity is called The Plush Dino, and resembles a dinosaur plushie. The plushie is sentient and capable of movement. Throughout the Level, it can be seen wandering around. Due to the effects on the Level, and the fact that the plushie induces content emotions, it is unknown whether or not harm is possible to the plush. It is incredibly helpful, typically appearing with some materials such as food and water to provide to the wanderer.
